verdict.rationale: PagerDuty ships its own official MCP server that lets AI assistants such as Claude Desktop, Cursor or VS Code interact with and manage incidents in an account, plus a Claude connector. Natively, the Insights Agent offers on-demand conversational insights, but that is scoped to analytics. Broad natural-language operation therefore depends on an external MCP-enabled AI client rather than a documented built-in command interface. Missing for 10: a first-party natural-language command interface covering general account operation, explicit documentation of natural-language commands for actions like acknowledging or resolving incidents, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
